newsitems.title: Hubert Release Update
newsitems.author: Sol!d_Sn@k3
newsitems.contents: Hey everyone,Unfortunately, we have some unexpected news. We planned to release Hubert today, but our game build is still waiting for review on Steam.We've submitted the build and are waiting for the review to be completed. We know many of you have been looking forward to playing Hubert, and we're just as disappointed that we can't share the game with you today as planned.We don't have a confirmed new release date yet, but we'll keep you updated and let you know as soon as we have more information.Thank you for your patience and support throughout Hubert's development. We've put a lot of ourselves into this game, and we're looking forward to finally seeing you play it.Thank you for understanding! ❤️ Brocap Studio

newsitems.title: Hubert is Heading to Tokyo Game Show!
newsitems.author: Sol!d_Sn@k3
newsitems.contents: We're incredibly excited to announce that Hubert will be attending Tokyo Game Show 2026!It's a huge milestone for our small independent studio from the Czech Republic. When we started working on Hubert, we never imagined our shepherd dog would one day make his way all the way to Tokyo.As we get closer and closer to release, we're taking Hubert to TGS to let more players experience the game, meet the people behind it, and share what we've been working on.If you're attending Tokyo Game Show, come find us, play Hubert to say hello! We'd love to meet you.Are you a native Japanese speaker? We'd love your help! We're looking for someone who could help us communicate in Japanese during Tokyo Game Show. If you're interested, please get in touch with us before the event!We're incredibly grateful to everyone who has followed Hubert's journey, added the game to their wishlist, played the demo, and supported us along the way. We're getting closer. 🐾See you at Tokyo Game Show!

newsitems.title: 20,000 WISHES! Hubert is officially a "Heavyweight" Breakout!
newsitems.author: Sol!d_Sn@k3
newsitems.contents: We are absolutely speechless. When the three of us started working on Hubert in our small studio in Brno, we dreamed of sharing this story with a few people. Today, we woke up to find that over 20,000 of you have added our scent-tracking hero to your wishlists during Steam Next Fest!What this means for our 3-person teamIn the world of indie development, these numbers are a lifeline. Because of your support, Hubert has moved from a "small project" to a trending heavyweight. This momentum ensures that we can focus 100% on polishing the final experience for our full release.A Note on the Journey AheadWe’ve seen the questions in the forums, and we want to be transparent: Hubert is a handcrafted, cinematic experience. It is designed to be a tight, emotional 3-hour journey (or about 5 hours if you’re a completionist!).We are focusing on high-fidelity polish over "endless hours." Think of it as a premium short story you can finish in a night. A story we hope stays with you long after the credits roll.What’s next?The Wolf Fighting Segment: We’ve seen your clips! We’re working on polish passes based on your demo feedback.Community Feedback: We are reading every forum post and bug report. Your input is helping us fine-tune the game for the full launch.Final Polish: We are entering the home stretch of development, ensuring that every animation and environment detail meets the standards you've seen in the demo. From the bottom of our hearts and from Hubert himself, Thank You.If you haven't played the demo yet, there's still time! Jump in, track some scents, claim you trees and let us know what you think in the forums.Onward to the full release! -- The Hubert Team (All three of us!)P.S.: If you want to help us climb back up the charts, leave a comment below! Every "Like" and comment helps the Steam algorithm find more players like you.

newsitems.title: Hubert is Ready for Handheld! Steam Deck Support Update
newsitems.author: Sol!d_Sn@k3
newsitems.contents: We’ve been hard at work ensuring that Hubert feels right at home on the Steam Deck. Whether you’re on a train or lounging on the couch, we want your experience with Hubert to be seamless.We have officially optimized the game to meet Valve’s "Verified" standards. Here is exactly what we’ve updated:Full Controller Support: Every menu and gameplay mechanic in Hubert is now fully navigable using the Steam Deck’s physical controls.Legible Text: We’ve scaled our UI and font sizes to ensure everything is crystal clear on the 1280 x 800 display.Native Glyphs: No "Press E" confusion! The game automatically detects your controller and displays the correct Steam Deck button icons.Proton Compatibility: We’ve tested Hubert extensively on SteamOS to ensure stable performance and no crashes.Seamless Entry: If you need to name a save file or enter text, the Steam Deck on-screen keyboard will now trigger automatically.🔧 Recommended Settings for Steam DeckTo get the best balance of visual fidelity and battery life, we recommend the following in-game settings:Resolution: 1280 x 800 (Native)Graphics Preset: MediumShadow Quality: LowFrame Limit: 30 FPSNote: Lowering Shadow Quality to Medium provides a significant performance boost on the Deck’s APU while keeping the rest of the world looking crisp on the High preset.Tested in the Real World!Hubert in action! We’ve been playtesting on the Deck at recent events, and the feedback has been fantastic. Seeing players take Hubert on the go has been a highlight for our team.Current Status: Playable & PolishedWhile we wait for the official "Green Checkmark" from Valve’s review team, the game is 100% playable from start to finish on the Deck right now.Developer Note: If you encounter any bugs while playing on handheld, please let us know in the Steam Discussion forums! Your feedback helps us get that official Verified badge even faster.Thank you for supporting Hubert!
